items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: "All right Cohen, you know all them. 'Night and Day,' not Cohen but 'Night and Day' all those pretty songs, they were all written by songwriters."

ctx.x: All right Cohen, you know all them. “Night and Day,” not Cohen but “Night and Day” all those pretty songs, they were all written by songwriters.
Who, can you think of a songwriter that you like that works from the guitar? I mean most of those guys played the piano.
